text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, March 25 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 3 vessels due by 9/5, no delays.
Hay point - Port closed from 0900 hrs. 24/3 due to approach of tropical cyclone Justin. All vessels have left the port. Four vessels waiting, 6 due by 16/4. Delays due to cyclone.
Dalrymple Bay - Port closed from 0900 hrs. 24/3 due to approach of tropical cyclone Justin. All vessels have left the port. Seven vessels waiting, 16 due by 16/4, delays due to cyclone.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 20 due by 23/4, no delays.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 7/4, no delays.
Brisbane - Five vessels due by 23/4, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 6 waiting, 14 due by 16/4, 4-5 days delay.
Dyke 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 10 waiting, 17 due by 15/5, 8-9 days delay.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 20 due by 27/6, no delays.
IRON ORE - Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored, 1 due 27/3.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 2 anchored, 6 due by 8/4.

Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Shippers advise that due to current shortage of fines and yandi fines, iron ore vessels may expeence some delays in berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. Berth A - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored, 5 due by 1/4. Berth B - 1 Loading, 4 anchored, 7 due by 1/4, 4 others due with no eta.
